title: "Font Not Embedded" Print Error: How to Embed Fonts in a PDF | SparkPrep
h1: How to fix the "font not embedded" error in your book PDF
description: Printer says a font isn't embedded in your PDF? Here's what it means and how to embed all fonts from Word, InDesign or Acrobat so your book prints exactly as you designed it.
platforms: Amazon KDP · IngramSpark · Barnes & Noble Press · Lulu
lead: An unembedded font is a font your PDF names but doesn't carry inside it. The printer's computer doesn't have it, so the file is rejected.
errorNote: Often listed with the font's name, such as "Font Garamond not embedded".
why:
A PDF can either carry its fonts inside it (embedded) or just name them and hope the next computer has them. Printers require every font to be embedded, even common ones like Arial or Times, so your book prints exactly as designed.

If a font isn't embedded, the printer's system would swap in a different font. Words move, lines break in new places, and pages can shift, so they reject the file instead.

steps: Click Options and tick PDF/A compliant ("ISO 19005-1 compliant"). This forces Word to embed every font.
Save, then check the fonts in Acrobat (below).
Choose the preset PDF/X-1a:2001. It embeds all fonts.
To check: File → Properties → Fonts tab. Every font should say "(Embedded)" or "(Embedded Subset)".
To fix: Tools → Print Production → Preflight, search for Embed missing fonts and run the fixup.
If a font can't be embedded, its license doesn't allow it. Switch to a font that does.

cta.text: Don't want to hunt font by font? SparkPrep finds every unembedded font in your PDF and exports a print-ready PDF/X-1a with all fonts embedded, in minutes.

faq.q: How do I check if fonts are embedded in a PDF?
faq.a: Open it in Adobe Acrobat and go to File, Properties, Fonts. Each font should show Embedded or Embedded Subset.

faq.q: Do standard fonts like Arial need to be embedded?
faq.a: Yes. Printers need every font embedded, including Arial, Times and Helvetica, which many programs skip by default.
